note: 40 moments: 32 real closed-market moments from the NVDA/USDG pool plus 8 awkward edge cases, walked as the approved flowchart. Right means the same sell/hold decision and the same yes/no at every step as Talos's code. Cost uses SERV's published per-token prices.
finding: Once the rule is a flowchart, the small model decides exactly as well as a frontier model at about 2% of the cost. That is the reason Talos compiles every rule into a graph, SERV's method.
trap: One real night fooled every model. On Tue 4 Aug NVDA rose 7.2% after the close; given the rule as a paragraph, the small model with and without SERV and the frontier model all read it as a 7% drop and said sell. Talos's code said hold, and Talos only trades when the model and the code agree, so it would not have sold into a rally.

prose.note: With the rule as a paragraph, SERV redacted the check names in its answer and reported its steps differently, so it scores lower on exact steps; its sell/hold decisions were right in 39 of 40. The frontier run stopped after 36 cases when the SERV credit ran out.
